title: Dispute, Resolution and Refund Standards by Healthy Options Card Tier
content:
Where a member questions a purchase on a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card, or a retailer sends money back for a returned item, four periods govern what happens and by when. All four are terms of the tier.

| Card tier | Calendar days after a purchase posts within which it may be disputed | Calendar days within which the plan settles a disputed purchase | Calendar days within which a provisional credit is put on the card | Calendar days a retailer's refund takes to reach the card |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Core | 60 | 45 | 10 | 7 |
| Select | 60 | 45 | 10 | 7 |
| Plus | 75 | 30 | 7 | 5 |
| Premier | 75 | 30 | 7 | 5 |
| Dual Complete | 90 | 21 | 5 | 3 |
| Chronic Care Plus | 90 | 21 | 5 | 3 |

The same terms, tier by tier, as the member is told them. A Core or Select cardholder has 60 calendar days from the posting of a purchase to question it, is given a provisional credit within 10 calendar days while the enquiry runs, and has the matter settled within 45 calendar days. A Plus or Premier cardholder has 75 calendar days to question a purchase, a provisional credit within 7 and a settlement within 30. A Dual Complete or Chronic Care Plus cardholder has 90 calendar days to question a purchase, a provisional credit within 5 and a settlement within 21.

The last column is not a dispute at all: it is the time a retailer's own refund for a returned item takes to reach a card of the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes — 7 calendar days on the Core and Select tiers, 5 on the Plus and Premier tiers and 3 on the Dual Complete and Chronic Care Plus tiers.
